question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: I am confident **to pass the examination.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**of passing the examination**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 

• The phrase "**confident of passing**" is the correct grammatical construction. 

• The preposition "**of**" is used with "confident" to indicate belief or assurance about achieving something. 

• Options 1, 2</strong
